CBSA.CICSBSA.ABNDFILE.recovery_why: etc/install/base/installjcl/BANK.csd: DEFINE FILE(ABNDFILE) ... RECOVERY(NONE) -- the abend log a backout must not undo

scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the map sent ERASE with the cursor on ACCNO; RETURN TRANSID('OCRA') LENGTH(21)

scenarios.name: pa1
scenarios.why: PA1: CONTINUE, nothing sent; RETURN TRANSID with the COMMAREA

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE: back to the main menu

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: PF12: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG, RETURN

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: SEND CONTROL ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: other-key
scenarios.why: PF5: WHEN OTHER -- 'Invalid key pressed.', SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no field modified: RM010 -- ABNDPROC LINKed (an ABNDFILE record) and ABEND HBNK

scenarios.name: credit
scenarios.why: account 1, '+' 100.50: BIF DEEDIT, the amount checked character by character and through FUNCTION NUMVAL into the COMP-2 WS-AMOUNT-AS-FLOAT; INQUIRE ASSOCIATION(EIBTASKN) gives the task's origin data (stated: a TERMINAL facility, so DBCRFUN treats it as a teller transaction), LINK DBCRFUN (run in the task: both balances +100.50, PROCTRAN 'CRE') -- 'Amount successfully applied to the account.', the new balances

scenarios.name: debit
scenarios.why: account 2, '-' 50.25: the float negated (COMPUTE * -1), DBCRFUN debits it (PROCTRAN 'DEB')

scenarios.name: credit-no-sign
scenarios.why: account 1, no sign typed (SIGNL 0) and '12': a whole amount, NUMERIC at once -- a credit

scenarios.name: payment-debit-insufficient
scenarios.why: a payment (origin facility type NONE: DBCRFUN's 496) debiting 500.50 from account 8, whose available balance is -50: DBCRFUN '3' -- 'Sorry insufficient funds available to process the request.'

scenarios.name: payment-credit-mortgage
scenarios.why: a payment credit to account 4, a MORTGAGE: DBCRFUN '4' -- the unexpected-error message with the code

scenarios.name: account-not-found
scenarios.why: account 50: DBCRFUN '1' -- 'Sorry but the ACCOUNT no was not found for SORTCODE 987654 . Amount not applied.'

scenarios.name: account-null-date
scenarios.why: account 5's last-statement date is NULL: DBCRFUN's SELECT -305, '2' -- 'due to an unexpected error.'

scenarios.name: account-zero
scenarios.why: account 00000000: 'Please enter a non zero account number.'

scenarios.name: bad-sign
scenarios.why: sign '*': 'Please enter + or - preceding the amount'

scenarios.name: amount-missing
scenarios.why: no amount (AMTL 0): 'The Amount entered must be numeric.'

scenarios.name: amount-embedded-space
scenarios.why: '1 0': the embedded-spaces message

scenarios.name: amount-letters
scenarios.why: '12a': the numeric-amount message

scenarios.name: amount-two-points
scenarios.why: '1.2.5': one decimal point only

scenarios.name: amount-three-places
scenarios.why: '1.125': up to two decimal places

scenarios.name: amount-leading-spaces
scenarios.why: '   12.75': UNSTRING from the first non-space, then credited

notes: CBSA's credit / debit screen (BNK1CRA, transaction OCRA, BMS map BNK1CD of mapset BNK1CDM: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1CDM.bms, @bms/BNK1CDM.cpy). Pseudo-conversational, as every CBSA screen (PF3 RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE from the stated terminal T001, oracle_assumptions.md X27). ENTER RECEIVEs the map (MAPFAIL abends HBNK through ABNDPROC), BIF DEEDITs the account number, checks it is not zero and the sign is + or -, validates the amount character by character and converts it with FUNCTION NUMVAL into the COMP-2 WS-AMOUNT-AS-FLOAT (negated for '-'), then INQUIREs its own ASSOCIATION for the origin data and LINKs DBCRFUN with SUBPGM-PARMS (run in the task, as in cbsa-dbcrfun). The task's origin data is a stated fact of the run (oracle_assumptions.md X29): APPLID CBSAREGN, user CICSUSER, facility T001, network CBSANET, facility type TERMINAL (a teller transaction to DBCRFUN), or NONE (DBCRFUN's 496, a payment) where a scenario says so. Every amount that reaches NUMVAL is exact in both IEEE and HFP (100.50, 50.25, 12.75, 1.5 ...): IBM's long HFP and the oracle's IEEE agree only on such values (oracle_assumptions.md C6). The COMMAREA compared is the one the program RETURNs, WS-COMM-AREA. ACCOUNT, PROCTRAN and ABNDFILE are compared after every scenario. Not reached: an account number with no digit after BIF DEEDIT (not modelled: refused) and the failure branches after SEND MAP / SEND TEXT / SEND CONTROL / RETURN / LINK / INQUIRE (no fault can be injected on them). Data: seed.sql is cbsa-dbcrfun's (SYNTHETIC).
